description: This file implements a time series data structure for collecting and aggregating statistical data at multiple resolutions, including classes and methods for managing observations, levels, and series at different granularities.

classes.name: Observable
classes.description: Interface for data that can be aggregated in a time series, supporting multiply, add, clear, and copy operations.

classes.name: Float
classes.description: Implementation of Observable for float64 values, with methods for string representation, multiplication, addition, clearing, and copying.

classes.name: defaultClock
classes.description: Default implementation of Clock that returns the current system time.

classes.name: tsLevel
classes.description: Represents a level in the time series, maintaining a circular list of buckets of observations.

classes.name: timeSeries
classes.description: Core data structure managing multiple levels of bucketed observations, supporting adding data, scaling, range queries, and aggregation.

classes.name: TimeSeries
classes.description: Main class for tracking data at granularities from 1 second to 16 weeks.

classes.name: MinuteHourSeries
classes.description: Series tracking data at 1-minute and 1-hour resolutions.

methods.name: NewFloat
methods.description: Creates a new Observable Float initialized to zero.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Float value.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the float's numeric value.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the Float value by a ratio.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds another Observable Float to this one.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the Float to zero.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Copies the value from another Observable Float.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Returns the current time from the Clock interface.

methods.name: InitLevel
methods.description: Initializes a tsLevel with specified size, number of buckets, and provider function.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all data in a tsLevel.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a timeSeries with specified resolutions, provider, number of buckets, and clock.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all observations from the timeSeries.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Records an observation at the current time.

methods.name: AddWithTime
methods.description: Records an observation at a specified time.

methods.name: mergeValue
methods.description: Inserts an observation at a specific past time into all levels.

methods.name: mergePendingUpdates
methods.description: Applies pending observations into all levels.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances buckets to accommodate a new timestamp.

methods.name: Latest
methods.description: Returns the sum of the latest buckets at a specified level.

methods.name: LatestBuckets
methods.description: Returns copies of the latest buckets at a specified level.

methods.name: ScaleBy
methods.description: Scales all observations by a given factor.

methods.name: Range
methods.description: Returns the sum of observations over a time range.

methods.name: Recent
methods.description: Returns the sum of observations from the last delta duration.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Returns the total sum of all observations.

methods.name: ComputeRange
methods.description: Computes approximate observations over a range divided into buckets.

methods.name: RecentList
methods.description: Returns a list of recent bucket observations.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts a slice of observations from a level over a range.

methods.name: resetObservation
methods.description: Resets or creates an Observable for reuse.

methods.name: Minute
methods.description: Returns the latest 60-minute buckets.

methods.name: Hour
methods.description: Returns the latest 60-hour buckets.
